paraphrase: In one stipulated three-world, three-individual universal-accessibility model, an actually populated world has a single shared roster root in every populated successor, an accessible empty extension, no necessarily present individual and no successor-relative guarantee of population. Every present nonroot has an in-world root cause, and no two causal edges can compose. The construction does not satisfy an unrestricted PSR or establish metaphysical possibility.
